title: Characterizing Bacterial Volatiles using Secondary Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry (SESI-MS)
protocol: Cultivate E. coli K12 aerobically in 50 mL of LB-Lennox medium at 37°C for 24 hours.
Cultivate P. aeruginosa PAO1 aerobically in 50 mL of LB-Lennox medium at 37°C for 24 hours.
Collect the headspace volatiles from the cultures using a carrier gas flow rate of 2 L/min.
Deliver the collected volatiles to the SESI reaction chamber.
Replace the original electrospray ion source with a custom-built SESI reaction chamber.
Set up the mass spectrometer for positive ion mode analysis.
Use 0.1% formic acid, 5.0% methanol, and 94.9% water (v/v) as the electrospray solution.
Deliver the electrospray solution at a rate of 5 nL/s through a non-conductive silica capillary with a sharpened needle tip (40 μm ID).
Apply an electrical voltage of 2.5 kV to the system.
Collect data using Analyst 1.4.2 software with parameters set for mass range from 20 – 500 Da, MCA mode, 40 scans, and a scan duration of 3 s/scan.
Conduct analysis over a total time of 2 minutes.
